questions.text: Which vegetable is famous for making people cry when chopped?
questions.explanation: Onions release a gas that irritates the eyes.

questions.text: Which fruit is said to keep the doctor away if eaten daily?
questions.explanation: The proverb is "an apple a day keeps the doctor away".

questions.text: Natural vanilla flavouring comes from the seed pods of which type of plant?
questions.explanation: Vanilla comes from the cured pods of climbing orchids of the genus Vanilla.

questions.text: Besides sugar cane, which root crop is a major source of the world's sugar?
questions.explanation: Sugar is extracted commercially from sugar beet.

questions.text: Which cereal crop is traditionally grown in flooded paddies?
questions.explanation: Rice is grown in flooded paddy fields across much of Asia.

questions.text: What is the green pigment in plants called?
Which plant is the source of the fibre used to make linen?
questions.explanation: Linen is woven from fibres of the flax plant.
Acorns are the fruit of oak trees.

questions.text: Which spice comes from the dried stigmas of a type of crocus?
questions.explanation: Saffron threads are the stigmas of Crocus sativus.

questions.text: Which farming practice alternates different crops on the same land through the seasons?
questions.explanation: Crop rotation helps preserve soil fertility.

questions.text: What is the genus name of the cacao tree, meaning "food of the gods"?
questions.explanation: Theobroma cacao is the source of chocolate.

questions.text: Which plant did Gregor Mendel use for his famous inheritance experiments?
questions.explanation: Mendel crossed pea plants in his monastery garden.

questions.text: Which tree bark is the source of quinine, used against malaria?
questions.explanation: Quinine is extracted from cinchona bark.

questions.text: Which agronomist led the wheat breeding of the Green Revolution and won the 1970 Nobel Peace Prize?
Which fruit depends on a species-specific tiny wasp for pollination?
questions.explanation: Fig wasps enter the fig's small opening to pollinate it.

spares.text: Which vegetable does Bugs Bunny famously munch?
spares.explanation: Bugs Bunny is rarely seen without a carrot.

spares.text: Which plant family includes sunflowers, daisies and lettuce?
spares.explanation: These all belong to the daisy family, Asteraceae.

spares.text: Which 18th-century Swedish botanist formalised the binomial naming system for species?
spares.explanation: Linnaeus popularised two-part Latin names for species.
